resources.string: Phones stop background apps to save battery. A sleep recording runs for hours with the screen off, so if the system stops Taiga at 3 am, that night is lost. A few minutes of setup makes this far less likely.
Could not detect your OS. These are the generic Android steps.
This is the main switch on OnePlus. In testing, Smart mode and Restrict stopped the recorder after about five minutes.
Tap Open app info below, then Battery usage.
Under Power consumption control, choose Allow background activity and confirm the dialog.
Do not choose Smart mode or Restrict background activity.
This feature targets apps that run overnight. Taiga cannot read this setting.
Open Settings, then Battery, then Power saving settings.
Set Sleep standby optimisation to Off.
Locking the card keeps the system from clearing Taiga when memory is low.
Open the recent apps screen and find Taiga Sleep.
Tap the menu on its card and choose Lock.
Restricted stops the recorder within about a minute, without any message.
Tap Open app info below, then Battery.
Keep Taiga out of sleeping apps
Samsung can put rarely used apps to sleep. It made no difference in testing, but it is a cheap safety margin.
Open Settings, then Battery, then Background usage limits.
Make sure Taiga Sleep is not under Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps.
Turn off Put unused apps to sleep.
Keep Taiga open in recent apps
Keeping the app open stops the system from clearing it when memory is low.
Open the recent apps screen and tap the Taiga Sleep icon above its card.
Allow Taiga to run in the background
This removes Taiga from Android\'s battery optimisation, so the system does not pause it while the phone sleeps.
If a popup asks to let the app always run in the background, choose Allow.
If no popup appears, find Taiga Sleep in the list and choose Don\'t optimise or Unrestricted.
Locking the app in recent apps keeps the system from clearing it when memory is low.
Open the recent apps screen and find Taiga Sleep.
Tap its icon or menu and choose Lock, Keep open or Pin. The name varies by phone.
Phones are much less aggressive about stopping apps while charging. It is the cheapest extra protection you have.
Plug in the phone before you go to sleep.
